_readme: FIAT ITEMS 29 (29 Oct, the itemisation): the 176 new bases' pictures and the three unique gloves - 179 jobs, all at $0.08 (every canvas under 65k px). One job a picture, straight to the live name art/items/<slug>.png (Items.art finds it by slug; nothing to wire), the footprint x 64 px from data.gd.
The item template of make_item_manifests (TAIL, ref_01..04 as style_image rotated, every style option on). Guns side-on, muzzle left (the stash icons' view, not the fight hands').
The Sparky's Gloves goes to art/items_new/ (its 64 px charm picture holds the live name): copy it over art/items/the_sparky_s_gloves.png once kept.
Run the test first: tools/pixellab_items29_test_manifest.json (eight of these jobs). Then this, ++ --parallel 3.
Regenerate with python3 tools/make_items29_manifest.py; check with python3 tools/art_lint.py.
